verdict.rationale: Rev AI is a SaaS speech-to-text API, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question. Its official docs site offers a single thin entry, "Install MCP server on Cursor", which shows a first-party MCP server an agent can connect to. Nothing describes what tools it exposes or whether it reaches the transcription API rather than just the documentation. missing for 10: documentation of the MCP server's tools and scope, setup/auth details, support for agents beyond Cursor, evidence it exposes transcription capabilities, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
